content.short: Eluvio Live lets users purchase movies, albums, and related content.
content.description: Eluvio Live leverages the Eluvio Content Fabric, a global platform for managing and distributing premium video and multimedia at Internet scale. It enables creators and their communities to store, stream, mint, ticket, and trade media with blockchain-based authorization, ownership, and privacy. Users can purchase films, music albums, and related extended content within Web3, while creators maintain control over access and rights through blockchain ownership signals, payments, and privacy-preserving flows. This approach supports transparent rights management and direct creator-to-audience economics.
content.meta: Eluvio Live enables blockchain-enabled media ownership and distribution. Discover Eluvio Live and other Web3 Social Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
